source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος που μαρτύρησε στις Κεντουκέλλες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is the man the 13 May page argues about, and that is why he is drafted here and not there.** saint.gr's 13 May entry «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος ο Μάρτυρας επίσκοπος Τιβεριανών» says of itself: «Εδώ γίνεται κάποια σύγχυση… Στους Συναξαριστές είναι καταχωρημένος χωρίς υπόμνημα. Αλλά μάλλον πρόκειται περί του Αλεξάνδρου» of the Lavriotic Codex 1170, a soldier in the company of the count Tiberianus from the diocese of Kentoulles or Kentoulines or Kelles, whom later writers «τον μεταμόρφωσαν σε επίσκοπο» and gave the title of a see that never existed — «βλέπε 14 Μαΐου». So the 13 May line was refused as a page arguing against its own entry, and the man himself is taken from the 14 May page, which states his soldiering plainly. **The display name says soldier of Tiberianus and not bishop**, for that reason, and `types` carries `soldier`. **He is not the day's other Alexander**, who is one of the three beheaded with Barbarus and Acoluthus and has his own page. **No year, so no `dates` object**: the page gives only the reign of Galerius Maximian, 286–305. **His mother Poimenia is named and has no folder.** **No `locations` object**: the place of martyrdom is the day line's Kentoukelles and the 13 May page cannot decide its spelling. No hymn is printed.
